headline: 5-1 rout: Netherlands dismantle Sweden in World Cup clash
summary: Brian Brobbey and Cody Gakpo both score doubles as the Dutch secure a dominant victory to top Group F.
details: The Netherlands cruised to an impressive 5-1 victory over Sweden in their World Cup match on Saturday, with Brian Brobbey and Cody Gakpo each netting two goals.

Brian Brobbey started the onslaught early, scoring twice in the first 17 minutes to give the Dutch an immediate advantage. Cody Gakpo added two more in a quick seven-minute spell after the second half began.
Crysencio Summerville capped off the rout with a neat finish in the final minute of the game. Anthony Elanga provided a lone consolation goal for Sweden in the 59th minute.

The Dutch performance was a response to a disappointing 2-2 draw against Japan in their opening game. Coach Ronald Koeman's tactical demands were met as the team underlined their status as tournament favorites.
Sweden, who had previously crushed Tunisia 5-1, struggled to contain the Dutch attack and gave the ball away too easily throughout the match.
With this result, the Netherlands now top Group F with four points, while Sweden remains on three points after two matches.

headline: Tragedy in Dhaka: College student found dead in capital
summary: The body of a college student was recovered from a residence in Dhaka, sparking concerns over youth mental health.
details: A college student's body was found hanging in the capital city of Dhaka.
Local authorities were notified of the incident, and the body was recovered from the residence.
The circumstances surrounding the death are being investigated by the police to determine the exact cause.
This incident adds to a growing number of reports regarding the mental health struggles of students in the city.
